title: Plan
subtitle: Where money is meant to go

teaching.title: Intention is not your bank balance
teaching.body: Jars are envelopes for intention. Real cash and accounts live in Money. Never read jar totals as bank balance.

jars.offlineBody: Plan changes need a connection. Nothing was saved.
